signature: Macht Ich Georg Ehe-Nurmberg [master’s mark: a head surrounded by beams]  MDCXIX
literature: Chouquet 1884: 162; Langwill 1980: 45; Young 1980: 43 (photo); Fischer 1984: 44; Lane 1982: 183; Barclay 1992: 104, n.2; Barclay 1997: 34; SmithD 1989: 30.
remarks: Richly decorated with fine engraved ornaments. Barclay 1997: 34 praises “the flawless toothed bell seam” on this instrument as “[p]erhaps the finest example of the solderer’s art on a musical instrument.”
